story: HI *{name}*! I'M *APOORV*, A DESIGNER FROM LUCKNOW.
*12+ YEARS*, FOUR COMPANIES, AND A LOT OF COFFEE.
INSTEAD OF A RESUME, I BUILT A GAME. *YOU'RE PLAYING MY STORY.*
WALK THROUGH MY STORY, COLLECT THE COINS AND MEET THE TEAM.

rita.name: RITA
lines: WELCOME, *{name}*! I'M RITA. I RUN THIS LOBBY.
YOU'RE ABOUT TO PLAY THROUGH *12+ YEARS* OF DESIGN. FIND THE GOLD *?* COINS TO LEARN THE STORY.
*ARROWS* TO WALK. HOLD *SHIFT* TO RUN. *UP* TO JUMP, *UP AGAIN* IN THE AIR FOR A DOUBLE JUMP.
*SHIFT+UP* IS A LONG JUMP. STAND ON A *GREEN PIPE* AND PRESS *DOWN* TO SLIDE INSIDE.
STUCK ANYWHERE? PRESS *R* TO RETURN TO THE LAST CHECKPOINT. NO PENALTY!
again: TEN GOLD *?* COINS, {name}. THE FIRST ONE IS JUST AHEAD!

raju.name: RAJU
lines: COFFEE, *{name}*? FRESH FROM THE PANTRY!
DESIGNERS RUN ON COFFEE. THIS ONE GIVES YOU *SPEED* AND A *TRIPLE JUMP*!
again: TOO MUCH COFFEE? NEVER. TAKE ANOTHER!

meera.name: MEERA
lines: WELL DONE, *{name}*! THAT'S THE LOBBY DONE.
I LIKE PEOPLE WHO TURN *COMPLEX IDEAS* INTO CLEAR STORIES. YOU JUST DID.
THROUGH THE DOOR IS THE *TRAINING CAMPUS*. SEE YOU THERE!
again: THE DOOR IS RIGHT THERE, {name}. NO MORE EXCUSES!

prof.name: PROF. DAS
lines: WELCOME TO THE *TRAINING CAMPUS*, {name}! I'M PROF. DAS.
FOUR DEGREES, FOUR CLASSROOMS. FINISH EACH *TASK* TO OPEN THE GATE AND EARN THE *SCROLL*.
RELAX, NO EXAMS. THIS IS WHERE I LEARNED TO *THINK*, NOT JUST DRAW.
again: FOUR GATES, {name}. START WITH THE COLOUR LAB!

profEnd.name: PROF. DAS
lines: FOUR SCROLLS, *{name}*! THAT'S A LOT OF LEARNING.
NEXT: THE *OFFICE FLOORS*, WHERE ALL OF THIS GOT PUT TO WORK.
again: THE DOOR IS OPEN, {name}. OFF YOU GO!

floor1.name: ZARA
lines: WELCOME TO THE *FREELANCE* FLOOR, {name}! 2013 TO 2016.
NO BOSS HERE, JUST *CLIENTS* AND DEADLINES. COLLECT THE 4 CLIENT BADGES TO GET THE ELEVATOR WORKING.
BHOOMI, VIBAANTA, GLOBAL EDUCATION AND 13JUGAAD.COM. EACH ONE TAUGHT ME SOMETHING.
again: FOUR BADGES, {name}. THEN TAKE THE ELEVATOR!

floor2.name: MEERA
lines: FLOOR 2: *BHOOMI EDUCATIONAL CONSULTANCY*. NOV 2016 TO DEC 2020.
MY FIRST FULL-TIME ROLE. OUR ENEMY: THE *VAGUE BRIEF*. STOMP IT TO TURN IT INTO A CLEAR DESIGN!
again: STOMP THE VAGUE BRIEF, {name}. TWICE SHOULD DO IT!

floor3.name: ANITA
lines: I'M THE CREATIVE DIRECTOR. WELCOME TO *DELOITTE DIGITAL*, JUN 2021 TO APR 2022.
TODAY'S ENEMY: THE *DEADLINE CLOCK*. NEWSPAPER ADS FOR THE US, UK AND AUSTRALIA. STOMP IT!
again: TICK TOCK, {name}. STOMP THE CLOCK!

floor4.name: SAM
lines: WELCOME TO *JLL*, BOSS! APR 2022 TO AUG 2024. YOU LEAD THIS TEAM.
ONE BRAND, MANY MARKETS. THE *OFF-BRAND BEAST* KEEPS CHANGING COLOURS. KEEP IT *CONSISTENT*!
again: WE'RE BEHIND YOU, {name}. THREE STOMPS!

floor5.name: THE CEO
lines: WELCOME TO *WSP*, AUG 2024 TO TODAY. THE LEADERSHIP MEETING STARTS SOON.
BUT THE *100-SLIDE DECK* IS LOOSE! MAKE IT CLEAR, {name}. STOMP IT!
again: THE MEETING IS WAITING, {name}. THREE STOMPS!

floor5End.name: THE CEO
lines: NOW *THAT* IS A DECK I CAN PRESENT. WELL DESIGNED, {name}!
THAT'S MY WHOLE JOURNEY SO FAR. NEXT: THE *SKILL ARCADE*.
again: GO ON, {name}. THE EXIT IS RIGHT THERE!

cheer.name: TEAM
lines: WE'RE WITH YOU, BOSS!
again: GO GET IT, BOSS!

skill1.name: RAVI
lines: WELCOME TO THE *SKILL ARCADE*, {name}! THREE CABINETS, *FIFTEEN* SKILLS.
EACH COIN IS A SKILL. GRAB IT TO SEE *WHERE I USED IT*. SOME COINS HIDE IN *PIPE ROOMS*.
THE BARS AT THE TOP SHOW HOW MANY YOU'VE FOUND IN EACH CABINET.
again: FIFTEEN SKILLS, {name}. YOU HAVE *{skills}* SO FAR!

skillEnd.name: RAVI
lines: *{skills}/15* SKILLS COLLECTED, {name}. NOT BAD AT ALL!
TWO WORLDS LEFT: THE *TROPHY HALL*, THEN THE *ROOFTOP*.
again: YOU HAVE *{skills}/15* SKILLS. ANY MISSING ONES ARE BACK IN THE PIPE ROOMS!

curator.name: MRS. KAPOOR
lines: WELCOME TO THE *TROPHY HALL*, {name}! I LOOK AFTER THESE SHELVES.
FIVE CERTIFICATES ARE WAITING. JUMP UP AND *HIT EACH ? BLOCK FROM BELOW* TO RELEASE ONE.
again: FIVE BLOCKS, {name}. HIT THEM FROM *BELOW*!

curatorEnd.name: MRS. KAPOOR
lines: *{certs}/5* CERTIFICATES, {name}! LEARNING NEVER STOPS, AND NEITHER DOES APOORV.
THE LAST STOP IS THE *ROOFTOP*. TAKE THE DOOR!
again: *{certs}/5* CERTIFICATES SO FAR, {name}. ANY MISSING BLOCKS?

rooftop.name: MEERA
lines: YOU MADE IT TO THE *ROOFTOP*, {name}! LOOK WHO CAME TO CHEER.
THE SIGNS BEHIND ME HAVE *HOW TO REACH ME*. WHEN YOU'RE READY, RAISE THE FLAG!
again: SIGNS FIRST, THEN THE FLAG, {name}!

bLinkedIn.name: LINKEDIN
lines: LET'S CONNECT ON *LINKEDIN*!
LINKEDIN.COM/IN/APOORV-CHAURASIA-152B51228
PRESS ENTER AGAIN TO *OPEN* IT.
again: LET'S CONNECT ON *LINKEDIN*!
LINKEDIN.COM/IN/APOORV-CHAURASIA-152B51228
PRESS ENTER AGAIN TO *OPEN* IT.

bEmail.name: EMAIL
lines: *EMAIL* ME ANYTIME:
APOORV.UK@GMAIL.COM
PRESS ENTER AGAIN TO *OPEN YOUR MAIL APP* AND COPY THE ADDRESS.
again: *EMAIL* ME ANYTIME:
APOORV.UK@GMAIL.COM
PRESS ENTER AGAIN TO *OPEN YOUR MAIL APP* AND COPY THE ADDRESS.

bPhone.name: PHONE
lines: *CALL OR WHATSAPP* ME:
PRESS ENTER AGAIN TO *COPY THE NUMBER*.
again: *CALL OR WHATSAPP* ME:
PRESS ENTER AGAIN TO *COPY THE NUMBER*.

bHire.name: THE FLAG
lines: THANKS FOR PLAYING, *{name}*!
*12+ YEARS*, FOUR COMPANIES, ONE DESIGNER, READY FOR THE *NEXT CHAPTER AT WSP*.
RAISE THE FLAG TO FINISH. THEN LET'S *TALK*!
again: RAISE THE FLAG TO FINISH, {name}!

bResume.name: RESUME
lines: PREFER A *CLASSIC RESUME*?
PRESS ENTER AGAIN TO *OPEN IT*.
again: PRESS ENTER AGAIN TO *OPEN* THE RESUME.

dragonIntro.name: MEERA
lines: STOP, *{name}*! THE *DEADLINE DRAGON* GUARDS THE EXIT.
IT BREATHES FIRE ALONG THE FLOOR, SO *JUMP* OR HOP ONTO THE *LEDGES*. WATCH THE FIREBALLS TOO!
WHEN IT GETS *TIRED*, STOMP ITS HEAD. FIVE TIMES SHOULD DO IT. GOOD LUCK!
again: STOMP ITS HEAD WHEN IT'S TIRED, {name}. NOT BEFORE!
